definitions.explanation: Describes something so frightening or horrifying that it makes one's body hair stand on end. Literally means 'even the hairs on one's body stand up.' Used for intense fear, horror, or revulsion.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつものだった。
examples.english: The details of that incident were spine-chilling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつような⟦{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}→叫び声：26924_sakebigoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すくんだ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧。
examples.english: On the dark mountain path, I heard a blood-curdling scream and my legs froze.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a prenominal modifier: {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつ + noun. Can also be used with ような to create a simile: {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつような⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (a hair-raising experience). よだつ means 'to stand on end.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (a hair-raising story)
- {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつ⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (a terrifying experience)
- {身|み}の{毛|け}もよだつような⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ (a horrifying sight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鳥肌|とりはだ}→鳥肌：08544_torihada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to get goosebumps — can be used for both fear and emotional excitement
- ⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧: one's spine freezes — similar intensity of fear
- ⟦ぞっと→ぞっと：05272_zotto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shudder — can be used for fear, cold, or horror
